commands: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== AGENT PROCESSES ==='; ps -axo pid=,command= | grep -Ei 'local.?agent|agent.*daemon|daemon.*agent' | grep -v grep || true; echo '=== OPEN PY/SCRIPT FILES FOR WORKER/SUPERVISOR ==='; for pid in $(ps -axo pid=,command= | grep -Ei 'local.?agent|agent.*daemon|daemon.*agent' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'); do echo PID=$pid; lsof -p $pid 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(py|pyc)$|/bin/|site-packages|Local.?Agent|local.?agent' | head -80 || true; done
